_: It.28: a PAID custom follower via a fully-CUSTOM recruit topic + result fragment. The vanilla paid path (PotentialHireling) can't recruit a custom NPC — its recruit INFOs are GetIsID-hardcoded per vanilla mercenary (probe: `modforge infodiag Skyrim.esm 0x0BCC84`). So we author our own topic, gated on GetIsID==our speaker (always passes), with an OnEnd Papyrus fragment (MFHirePaidRecruit) that takes 500 gold and joins her to CurrentFollowerFaction (0x05C84E) + SetPlayerTeammate — after which the GENERIC vanilla follow/wait/dismiss dialogue works (it keys on that faction + follower voice, no GetIsID). Counterpart to follower_hireable_spec.json (the FREE-follow path). She must NOT be in PotentialHireling (the generic follower dialogue requires PotentialHireling==0). `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, talk to her, pick the 500-gold line.

npcs.name: Brynja the Hired
npcs._greeting: Makes her conversable (host quest + Hello). The custom recruit topic surfaces on top.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — a VoicesFollowerNeutral voice, required so the generic vanilla follow/wait/dismiss dialogue (GetIsVoiceType) surfaces once she's in CurrentFollowerFaction.
npcs._factions: Only Whiterun crime/citizen (door/gate traversal). NO PotentialHireling/PotentialFollower — the recruit is our own topic, and the generic follower dialogue needs PotentialHireling==0.

quests._: Hosts the custom recruit topic. StartGameEnabled so the topic is evaluated/served when you talk to her.
quests.name: ModForge Paid Hire

dialogue._: Custom recruit line. speakerNpcEditorId adds GetIsID==Brynja (so only she offers it). goodbye closes the menu. The OnEnd fragment MFHirePaidRecruit does the gold check + transaction + follower-join — all logic lives in Papyrus, not JSON. resultProperties bind the fragment's Auto properties to vanilla forms + the gold cost / relationship rank.
dialogue.prompt: Here's 500 gold. Fight at my side.

placements._: Brynja in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room (any in-room coord; actors snap to navmesh).
